profile_text.body:
# Saul

WealthCounsel, operating under the domain counsel.com, provides legal document software and continuing legal education resources for attorneys specializing in estate planning, trust administration, and related practice areas. The company offers multiple membership tiers, with its Elite membership providing access to Wealth Docx® Complete, Elder Docx™, Business Docx®, Wealth Tracx®, and Gun Docx®, while the Trusts & Estates Professional membership includes Wealth Docx® Complete, Business Docx®, Wealth Tracx®, and Gun Docx®.

The platform's document drafting tools cover estate planning, elder law, special needs planning, Veterans pension planning, business succession, and firearms trusts. WealthCounsel additionally offers continuing legal education courses, practice management integration through partnerships like LEAP, marketing resources, and a content library of articles and videos for practitioners. The company describes its offerings as cloud-based solutions designed for drafting basic to complex legal documents across charitable planning, asset protection, and retirement contexts.

According to theworldofai.org's product tracking, Saul offers SaulLM, a French legal-domain language model with specialized training and European data governance considerations, representing the company's venture into AI-assisted legal tools.
